reason: VIII Corps command post moved 120 miles from the Saint-Malo area to Lesneven on 18 August to open the Brest siege (documented hq_move).
29th Division left Brittany on 24 September to rejoin First Army and its command post is next listed in the Netherlands on 29 September (rail and motor move of about 800 km).
6th Armored Division moved from Brittany to the Third Army front in Lorraine in mid-September; the Green Book gives the move and the CMH list dates the two command posts.

7th Armored Division, landed at Omaha Beach, was ordered on 13 August to pass through Le Mans to La Ferté-Bernard and on 14 August to attack toward Dreux; the Green Book describes the hurried road march.
Panzer Lehr was ordered up on 7 June for a 90-mile drive from the Chartres area to the Thury-Harcourt assembly areas (documented relocation in C0038).

Pont-l'Abbé here is the hamlet astride Picauville and Étienville (Manche); the stored point is the Étienville commune centroid. The one stored geocoder candidate for the name is Pont-l'Abbé in Finistère, 265 km away, a namesake.
